headline: Cross-Market Rotation Analysis: Leadership Broadens Across Technology, European Equities, and Select Industry Themes
market_regime: Divergent Multi-Horizon Rotation with Regional and Sector Leadership Dispersion
executive_summary: Quantitative rotation data as of August 17, 2026, reflects persistent cross-sectional leadership in cloud computing and Eurozone equities, alongside emerging momentum in international small caps, metals and mining, and select country funds. Short-term performance divergence is prominent across Health Care, Energy, and Industrials, while defensive themes such as Food & Beverage and Utilities remain in confirmed rotation-out states. Confirmed 3-observation trend states highlight clear differentiation between short-bar momentum and longer-term relative strength profiles across asset classes.

emerging_rotations.title: Africa ETF Shows Strong Short-Term Momentum
emerging_rotations.explanation: AFK holds a confirmed EMERGING state with a rotation score of 81.88, registering a 5-bar score change of +17.50 and a 20-bar score change of +37.50, while hitting a 63-bar score high of 81.88. Relative strength evidence across horizons is mixed, as 20-bar relative strength is positive at +4.93 percentage points while 63-bar relative strength remains negative at -4.25 percentage points.

emerging_rotations.title: Metals & Mining Demonstrates Rapid 20-Bar Rebound
emerging_rotations.explanation: XME maintains a confirmed EMERGING state with a rotation score of 62.10 and a substantial 20-bar score change of +51.73, despite a modest 5-bar score change of -2.81. Relative strength indicators reflect divergent horizons, showing strong 20-bar relative strength of +16.71 percentage points against a negative 63-bar relative strength of -2.56 percentage points.

emerging_rotations.title: Japan Leadership Emerging with Broadening Momentum
emerging_rotations.explanation: EWJ is confirmed in an EMERGING state with a score of 74.31, supported by a 5-bar score change of +21.87 and a 20-bar score change of +29.92. Positive relative strength across both horizons confirms the shift, with 20-bar relative strength at +2.65 percentage points and 63-bar relative strength at +1.20 percentage points.

accelerating_rotations.title: Global Health Care Maintains Confirmed Acceleration
accelerating_rotations.explanation: IXJ holds a confirmed ACCELERATING state with a rotation score of 68.33, ranking 2nd in global sectors. Relative strength evidence shows split horizon characteristics with 20-bar relative strength at -0.52 percentage points and 63-bar relative strength at +6.48 percentage points. A pending raw WEAKENING condition is present with 2/3 observations recorded.

persistent_leaders.title: Cloud Computing Continues Top Cross-Sectional Leadership
persistent_leaders.explanation: SKYY retains its confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER state, ranking 1st in US industry themes with a rotation score of 97.00. The fund exhibits strong positive relative strength across both horizons, with 20-bar relative strength at +14.60 percentage points and 63-bar relative strength at +21.46 percentage points, accompanied by a 5-bar score change of +5.70.

persistent_leaders.title: Eurozone Blue Chips Reach 63-Bar Score High
persistent_leaders.explanation: FEZ holds a confirmed PERSISTENT_LEADER state with a rotation score of 94.17, reaching its 63-bar score high. Score momentum remains strong with a 20-bar score change of +46.04 and a 5-bar score change of +9.17, supported by positive relative strength of +1.13 percentage points over 20 bars and +5.32 percentage points over 63 bars.

persistent_leaders.title: Cybersecurity Maintains High Multi-Horizon Relative Strength

geographic_rotations.explanation: EWJ displays an EMERGING rotation state with a score of 74.31, supported by 20-bar score improvement of +29.92 and positive relative strength across 20-bar (+2.65 percentage points) and 63-bar (+1.20 percentage points) horizons.

cross_market_confirmations: European regional strength in FEZ (score 94.17) is confirmed by persistent single-country leadership in Poland (EPOL score 77.78).
Global Technology leadership in IXN (score 81.67) aligns with US thematic cloud computing dominance in SKYY (score 97.00).
Broad weakness in defensive equities is confirmed across both domestic Utilities (XLU score 21.82) and Food & Beverage (PBJ score 14.00).
risks_or_conflicts: Health Care exhibits significant within-sector divergence between improver IHI (20-bar score change of +35.70) and deteriorator IHF (20-bar score change of -38.89).
Energy displays material within-sector divergence between improver OIH (20-bar score change of +42.90) and deteriorator XOP (20-bar score change of -24.87).
Industrials reflects within-sector divergence between improver ITA (20-bar score change of +32.99) and deteriorator IYT (20-bar score change of -25.22).

IWD exhibits pair state tension versus paired ticker IWF: IWD carries a confirmed WEAKENING state while maintaining a confirmed PAIR_LEADING signal based on its 63-bar spread of +10.22 percentage points, despite a negative 20-bar spread of -0.78 percentage points.

REET exhibits pair state tension versus paired ticker XLRE: REET carries a confirmed WEAKENING state while holding a confirmed PAIR_LEADING signal based on its 63-bar spread of +0.45 percentage points, despite a negative 20-bar spread of -0.80 percentage points.
methodology_note: Interpretation uses Python-confirmed trend states that require 3 consecutive daily observations before a new raw condition becomes canonical. Raw conditions remain available as pending early warnings. Evidence also uses deterministic 5-bar score changes, 20- and 63-bar relative strength or pair spreads, persistence metrics, and Python-calculated attention flags including 63-bar rotation-score extrema and material cross-market conflicts. ETF volume and CMF are treated as market-participation indicators, not fund-flow data.
